nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What did Hooper et al. (2012) report about yields in short and simplified crop rotations?
nodes.answer: Hooper et al. (2012) reported a yield reduction of 5 to 10% in response to a 21 to 40% decrease in crop species.
